user.title: Connect to UniFi Network
user.description: Enter the connection details of your UniFi Network application. The official UniFi Network API is used.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the UniFi console or controller.
data_description.api_key: Create an API key in the Integrations section of your UniFi Network application.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only if the controller uses a self-signed certificate.

site.title: Select site
site.description: The UniFi Network application manages several sites. Select the site to add. Add the integration again for further sites.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate UniFi Network
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {host} is no longer valid. Please enter a new one.

error.site_not_found: The configured site no longer exists or the API key has no access to it.

abort.no_sites: No sites were found for this API key.
